battle.name: 岷州之戰
battle.brief: 武德六年（623）四月，吐谷渾犯岷州等邊州，秦州刺史柴紹馳援，六月二十九日在岷州山谷遭居高包圍；柴紹以胡琵琶女舞擾敵，敵停弓駐足，遂遣精騎繞背突擊，斬首五百餘級。卡面希臘重步兵屬公元前五世紀方陣戰士，相隔逾千年不在此役現場；同期唐軍用長刀步槊，吐谷渾以弓矢標槍騎射。

kit.name: 希臘重步兵
kit.history: 方陣的重心不是個人，是互相遮蔽。盾牌接在一起時，一支軍隊的正面比一個人結實。

countries: 這場戰爭是唐初隴右邊防與吐谷渾之間的一連串邊州爭奪，岷州之役是其中記錄較詳的一段，時間落在唐高祖武德年間。唐朝一方由中央直轄的邊州軍鎮與行台系統組成：主將是秦州刺史柴紹，岷州設總管李長孫，芳州刺史房當樹、河州刺史盧士良、洮州刺史且末生、武州刺史賈拔各守一線，益州行台右僕射竇軌奉詔率軍馳援，扶州刺史蔣善合則在後續戰鬥中收拾殘局。行台是唐初設置的軍政區，位在州與都督府之上，可以統調數州兵力，這套體系正是在與吐谷渾的反覆交鋒中成形。吐谷渾一方是鮮卑慕容部在青海與甘肅西部建立的游牧政權，史籍形容其人善控弦，騎兵是唯一的骨幹，兵無定居，隨牲畜轉徙，並不與唐廷共享任何邊界的概念；同時它又拉攏羌人部落党項作前驅，兩部聯兵入寇是此後十年的常態。623年四月，吐谷渾趁唐朝主力被劉黑闥與薛仁杲牽制在關東與隴東，兵鋒直指岷州、洮州一帶，兩軍在隴西南的山谷地帶第一次正面交鋒。
countriesEn: This war was a chain of frontier disputes between early Tang border defence and the Tuyuhun along the Longnan route in the far west of the empire, and the action at Minzhou is the best documented episode of them, all of it falling in the Wude era of Emperor Gaozu of Tang. On the Tang side stood a network of directly administered border prefectures and regional headquarters. The commander was Chai Shao, Prefect of Qinzhou; Minzhou had its own Chief Commissioner, Li Zhangsun; the prefects of Fangzhou, Fang Dangshu, of Hezhou, Lu Shiliang, of Taozhou, Qie Mosheng, and of Wuzhou, Jia Ba, each held a section of the line; the Right Vice President of the Palace of Yizhou, Dou Gui, was summoned with troops to relieve the front; and the Prefect of Fuzhou, Jiang Shanhe, tidied up the aftermath in the fighting that followed. A xingtai was a military administrative region established in the early Tang, standing above the prefectures and the commanderies and able to move troops across several prefectures, and this system was itself forged in the repeated clashes with Tuyuhun. Tuyuhun on the other side was a nomadic polity founded by the Xianbei Murong clan in Qinghai and western Gansu. Chinese histories describe its people as skilled with the bow; cavalry was its sole backbone; the army had no fixed abode and moved with the herds, and it shared no conception of a frontier with the Tang court. At the same time Tuyuhun drew the Qiang tribe of Dangxiang in to serve as its spearhead, and the two invading together became the normal condition of the following decade. In April 623, while the main Tang armies were pinned in the east and in eastern Longxi by Liu Heita and Xue Rengao, the Tuyuhun thrust aimed straight at Minzhou, Taozhou and the neighbouring counties, and the two sides met face to face for the first time in the valleys of south-western Longyou.
people: 柴紹是本役的關鍵人物。他是唐高祖李淵的女婿，尚平陽昭公主，年少時以將門子弟從軍，隋末唐初的幾次大戰都有他在其中；可以確定的是他參與過平定宋金剛的戰事，並在關中與山東之間轉戰多年。武德六年，他以秦州刺史的身份領兵出救岷州，正是以一支不大的兵團在山谷中逆轉局面的人。史籍稱他善用奇計，六月二十九日山谷之戰的主意正是他出的：命人彈起胡琵琶，又找來兩名美豔女子相對舞踏，吐谷渾騎兵看得莫名其妙，紛紛停弓駐足觀看，他趁這個空檔派精騎繞到敵軍背後，一擊而潰之，斬首五百餘級。前方各地則由岷州總管李長孫、芳州刺史房當樹、河州刺史盧士良、洮州刺史且末生、武州刺史賈拔各按自己的防區作戰，益州行台右僕射竇軌居中調度；後來扶州刺史蔣善合在武德七年赤磨鎮、岷州都督李道彥在貞觀二年，也都曾再挫吐谷渾。吐谷渾方面的最高決策者是其可汗，唐史系年所記的當時在位者為伏耿雄，但本役的指揮細節在漢文史料中完全空白，正面交鋒由前線騎兵首領自行決定；柴紹的奇計之所以奏效，正因為對手沒有更高的統一部署可以牽制各部。
peopleEn: Chai Shao is the decisive figure of the action. He was a son-in-law of Tang Gaozu Li Yuan, married to Princess Pingyang, and as a young man from a military household he followed the campaigns of the Sui-Tang transition; it is certain that he took part in the suppression of Song Jingang and campaigned for years between Guanzhong and the eastern plains. In Wude 6 he led troops out of Qinzhou to relieve Minzhou, and he was the man who turned the situation in a valley with a force that was not large. The histories credit him with a talent for odd stratagems, and the plan of 29 June was his: he ordered his men to play the hu pipa, brought in two beautiful girls to dance facing each other, and the Tuyuhun riders, staring in bewilderment, let their bows fall and stopped to watch. He used the moment to send elite cavalry round to the enemy's rear and shatter them in one stroke, cutting down more than five hundred heads. Meanwhile, along the front, Chief Commissioner Li Zhangsun of Minzhou, Fang Dangshu of Fangzhou, Lu Shiliang of Hezhou, Qie Mosheng of Taozhou and Jia Ba of Wuzhou each fought inside their own defended sector, with Dou Gui of the Yizhou xingtai coordinating in the middle. Later, Jiang Shanhe of Fuzhou won at Chimo in Wude 7, and Li Daoyan as Chief Military Commissioner of Minzhou turned back another raid in Zhenguan 2. On the Tuyuhun side the highest decision lay with the khagan, who in the Tang-era chronology was Fugengxiong, but the command detail of this action is completely blank in the Chinese sources: the frontal clash was decided by the leaders of the forward cavalry themselves. Chai Shao's ruse worked precisely because there was no higher unified plan on the other side to hold the enemy to it.
kits: 卡面的希臘重步兵是公元前五世紀希臘城邦的典型兵種：全副武裝的重裝步兵列入方陣，圓盾遮蔽身體與左側同伴，約兩公尺長的長矛平舉過肩，青銅頭盔、青銅胸甲與護脛加身，能在方陣的遮蔽下以整體前推。它的價值從來不在單挑，而在盾牆接合成一面；這位戰士與623年的岷州之役相隔一千一百餘年，不可能出現在隴西南的戰場上，兩軍真正交手的是另一批兵器。唐軍的近身冷兵器以長刀與步槊為主，弓弩用於壓制城障與遮蔽進逼，騎兵配馬鐙鞍具、持馬刀與長槊；吐谷渾騎兵靠皮甲、弓矢、標槍與馬刀作戰，馬上是生活，兵隨畜走，轉戰極快，不攻堅壘而抄邊州、驅牲畜、斷糧道。兩軍的共同點在於都不把個人當作戰力的單位：唐軍步騎結合成隊，騎兵迂迴時全隊同步壓上；吐谷渾則以居高的射陣與流動的騎列互相支援。本役勝負的關鍵並不在兵刃的銳利，而在體力與地形的配合——山谷限制了吐谷渾騎兵的縱馳，正好讓唐軍的盾兵與長槊站住陣腳，把對方拖入不利於衝鋒的地形。
kitsEn: The hoplite on the card is the classic soldier of the fifth-century BC Greek city states: a fully equipped heavy infantryman stood in the phalanx, his round shield covering his body and the man on his left, his roughly two-metre spear carried level at shoulder height, with bronze helmet, bronze cuirass and greaves, so that the whole line advanced under cover as one body. Its value never lay in single combat but in the fact that the shields locked into a wall; this soldier stands more than eleven hundred years away from the battle of Minzhou in 623 and could not have stood on a battlefield in south-western Longyou, and the weapons that actually met there were a different matter altogether. The close combat arms of the Tang were long sabres and foot spears, with bows and crossbows used to cover approaches and to silence strongpoints; the cavalry rode with saddle and stirrup and carried sabre and long spear. Tuyuhun riders fought in leather armour with bow, javelin and sabre; their life was on horseback, the army moved with the animals, and it was fast, never assaulting walled positions but raiding the border prefectures, driving off livestock and cutting supply lines. What the two armies shared was that neither treated the individual as the unit of force: the Tang combined foot and horse into teams and the cavalry pressed round in step with the whole formation; Tuyuhun supported one another with a firing line holding the heights and columns of riders in movement. The difference that decided the day lay not in the sharpness of the blades but in the fit of bodies and terrain: the valley denied the Tuyuhun horse its long gallop and held the Tang spearmen and shielded foot in place, dragging the enemy into ground unfavourable to the charge.
tactics: 本役的經過可以分兩段看。前段是四月至六月的接戰與行軍：四月二十一日吐谷渾軍進擾洮州、岷州，柴紹五月初五率兵相救，五月十五日吐谷渾與党項轉攻河州，被河州刺史盧士良擊退，柴紹其後才於六月抵達岷州。真正的交鋒在六月二十九日：柴紹大軍入谷後被吐谷渾軍包圍，敵軍占據高地，居高臨下放箭，箭密如雨，唐軍被壓在谷底無法展開。柴紹的破解辦法不是硬衝，而是以聲音與舞蹈製造短暫的注意力轉移，讓敵軍停弓駐足，再派騎兵繞行山谷，從敵軍背後出擊，一舉而潰敵。這與希臘方陣的思路恰好構成一組對照：方陣以正面疊盾換取縱深與遮蔽，攻方無論如何都要先在正面付出代價；唐軍這裡卻完全放棄正面，繞到敵人視線之外下手，說明在隴右山地，騎兵機動與心理奇襲比正面消耗更有效。補給方面，柴紹由秦州出發，沿隴右渭水上游北道再折入洮水流域的岷州，兵糧依賴州縣儲積與沿線驛傳。史料未留下本役的糧秣數目，只留下五月初五、五月十五日與六月二十九日這類行程節點，由此可看出前線拉鋸前後遷延約兩個月。
tacticsEn: The action can be read in two stages. The first runs from April to June, the Tang approaching and taking contact: on the twenty-first day of the fourth month the Tuyuhun army harried Taozhou and Minzhou; Chai Shao set out to succour them on the fifth day of the fifth month; on the fifteenth of the fifth month the Tuyuhun and Dangxiang turned on Hezhou and were beaten back by the prefect Lu Shiliang; and only in June did Chai Shao reach Minzhou. The real clash came on the twenty-ninth day of the sixth month. The Tang army entered the valley and found itself surrounded by the Tuyuhun, who held the high ground and shot down into the valley so that the arrows fell like rain, pinning the Tang on the floor of the gorge where they could not deploy. Chai Shao's answer was not a frontal assault but a short diversion of attention created by sound and dance, which made the enemy lower its bows and stand watching, after which he sent cavalry round through the valley to fall on the Tuyuhun from behind and shatter them. This sets up a sharp contrast with the Greek phalanx: the phalanx buys depth and cover by stacking shields on the front, so any attacker must first pay a price head-on, whereas the Tang here abandoned the front altogether and struck where the enemy could not see. In the mountains of Longyou the lesson of 623 was that cavalry movement and psychological surprise told better than a frontal grind of strength. As for supply, Chai Shao marched out of Qinzhou, moving north along the upper Wei and then turning into the Tao river basin towards Minzhou, and the grain came from prefectural stores and the relay stations along the line. The histories leave no figures for the grain and baggage of this action, recording only such nodes as the fifth and fifteenth of the fifth month and the twenty-ninth of the sixth month, from which the whole business can be seen to have dragged on for some two months.
data: 可以核對的數字不多，這正是本役記載的特點。時間線最清楚：武德五年（622）六月，吐谷渾軍進犯泮州、旭州、疊州三州，被岷州總管李長孫擊破；八月再犯岷州，反而打敗李長孫；武德六年（623）四月二十一日，吐谷渾軍進擾洮州、岷州二州；五月初五，秦州刺史柴紹率兵相救；五月十五日，吐谷渾與党項犯河州，被盧士良擊敗；六月二十九日，柴紹大軍在岷州山谷遭包圍而反勝，斬首五百餘級；八月，吐谷渾請和。兵力方面，兩軍人數在傳世史籍中均無記載，本役唯一可以確定的戰果數字就是斬首五百餘級，至於戰鬥延續多久、突圍損失多少，史料都留白。地理上能確定的只有地點：岷州治所在溢樂縣，即今甘肅岷縣，戰場在州城一帶的山谷之中，秦州、洮州、芳州、河州、松州分佈在周邊數百里內，構成互相援應的邊州鏈。作戰頻率同樣有紀錄支撐：自622年六月至626年六月，吐谷渾先後犯泮州、旭州、疊州、岷州、芳州、洮州、河州、松州、扶州、鄯州、蘭州等地，幾乎每年都有出兵，說明這條線上的摩擦是常態而非偶發。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked are few, and that is the character of the record. The timeline is the clearest part. In the sixth month of Wude 5 (622) the Tuyuhun army invaded the prefectures of Ban, Xu and Die and was beaten back by the Chief Commissioner of Minzhou, Li Zhangsun; in the eighth month they invaded Minzhou again and this time defeated Li Zhangsun; on the twenty-first day of the fourth month of Wude 6 (623) the Tuyuhun harried the prefectures of Taozhou and Minzhou; on the fifth day of the fifth month the Prefect of Qinzhou, Chai Shao, marched to their relief; on the fifteenth of the fifth month the Tuyuhun and Dangxiang invaded Hezhou and were defeated by Lu Shiliang; on the twenty-ninth day of the sixth month Chai Shao's army, surrounded in the valley of Minzhou, reversed the situation and cut down more than five hundred heads; and in the eighth month Tuyuhun sued for peace. Numbers of men are not recorded on either side in the transmitted histories, and the only certain figure for the action itself is the more than five hundred heads cut off; how long the fighting lasted, and what the escape cost, the sources leave blank. Geographically only the place is certain: the seat of Minzhou was in the county of Yile, that is Min county in Gansu today, and the battlefield lay in the valleys around the prefectural seat, with Qinzhou, Taozhou, Fangzhou, Hezhou and Songzhou spread across the hundreds of li around it in a chain of mutually supporting border posts. The frequency of the fighting is likewise borne out by the record: between the sixth month of 622 and the sixth month of 626 the Tuyuhun raided Ban, Xu, Die, Minzhou, Fangzhou, Taozhou, Hezhou, Songzhou, Fuzhou, Shanzhou and Lanzhou in turn, almost every year bringing an expedition, which shows that the friction on this line was the normal condition and not an accident.
cause: 起因分三層。第一層是實力對比：唐初關中甫定，兵制正從府兵向募兵與蕃兵過渡，西線只靠各州刺史與行台維持，兵不多、糧不裕，沒有能力壓制游牧政權的機動作戰。吐谷渾看準這一點，在唐軍主力被劉黑闥與薛仁杲黏在關東與隴東、對西北無法分兵時放手犯邊。第二層是地盤與資源：吐谷渾與党項的牧群需要季節性的草場與冬牧地，岷州、洮州、芳州、疊州一帶正是隴西南與青藏高原東緣的通道，漢地設州駐兵既是行政也是屏障，抄破這些州縣，就等於取得草場、取得牲畜、取得下一次出兵的踏板。第三層是邊防本身的空虛：吐谷渾進攻芳州時，刺史房當樹直接逃往松州，說明邊州守備薄弱、吏員不足，朝廷一時也補不上。吐谷渾選在四月動手，亦有季節上的道理——春夏草長馬肥，騎兵行動最利落，正是抄掠的好時節，而唐廷那時正把注意力全放在關東平定劉黑闥。無論如何分層，直接導火線就是623年四月吐谷渾軍進犯芳州、松州與洮州、岷州，唐朝必須回應。
causeEn: The causes lie in three layers. The first is the balance of strength. Tang had only just settled Guanzhong, its military system was in transition from the fubing towards recruited troops and auxiliary peoples, and the western line was held only by the prefects of the border districts and by the xingtai, with few men and thin grain and no capacity to pin down the mobile warfare of a nomadic state. Tuyuhun read this correctly, and struck at the border precisely when the main Tang armies were tied down in the east and in eastern Longxi by Liu Heita and Xue Rengao, with nothing to spare for the north-west. The second layer is land and resources. The herds of Tuyuhun and Dangxiang needed seasonal grazing and winter pastures, and the belt of Minzhou, Taozhou, Fangzhou and Diezhou was exactly the corridor between south-western Longyou and the eastern edge of the Tibetan plateau. Chinese prefectures with stationed troops were at once administration and barrier, and to break them was to take pasture, to take cattle, and to take a springboard for the next sortie. The third layer is the emptiness of the frontier defence itself: when the Tuyuhun attacked Fangzhou, the prefect Fang Dangshu simply fled to Songzhou, which shows how thin the border garrisons were and how short of officials the court was, and it could not fill the gap in a moment. That Tuyuhun chose to move in the fourth month had a seasonal logic as well: grass grows and horses grow fat in spring and summer, cavalry is at its best, and raiding is easiest, while the Tang court at that moment had all its attention turned east against Liu Heita. Whatever the layering, the immediate occasion was the Tuyuhun incursion into Fangzhou, Songzhou and the prefectures of Taozhou and Minzhou in April 623, and Tang had to answer it.
impact: 影響分遠近兩層。近期看，岷州之役讓唐朝第一次用邊州自身的兵力把吐谷渾的年度入寇頂了回去，還不必動用關東主力，這套以州兵守邊、以行台調援的辦法此後被反覆使用：武德七年蔣善合在赤磨鎮擊敗聯兵，貞觀二年李道彥在岷州都督任內再退來犯之敵，直到貞觀六年吐谷渾犯蘭州才被挫敗。遠期看，這條西線最終通向唐太宗對吐谷渾的全面戰爭：貞觀八年以段志玄為西海道行軍總管大舉反擊，次年以李靖為西海道行軍大總管深入青海，滅其國，吐谷渾遂成唐朝屬國，餘眾分置羈縻州，改慕容姓為尉遲氏，牧地與良馬盡入版籍。岷州之戰可以說是這場大規模行動的先聲，它同時也把一個問題留給後人：單靠州兵與奇襲，只能守住線，不能消滅對手，因此唐廷後來才會在西北建立道級的戰區指揮與常備的邊軍屯戍體系。而對吐谷渾來說，此役之後暫時收手，八月請和，換來數年的安寧，也讓其勢力在唐朝注意力轉向北方之際得以恢復，直到貞觀九年前後才被徹底解決。
impactEn: The effects work at two distances. In the near term, the action of Minzhou showed Tang for the first time that the frontier prefectures could push back a Tuyuhun invasion on their own, without committing the main army from the east, and that method of holding the border with prefectural troops and relieving them from the xingtai was used again and again: Jiang Shanhe beat the allied Tuyuhun and Dangxiang at Chimo in Wude 7, Li Daoyan turned back another raid in his term as Chief Military Commissioner of Minzhou in Zhenguan 2, and the Tuyuhun did not suffer a serious check until their raid on Lanzhou was beaten back in Zhenguan 6. In the longer term this western line led to the great Tang campaign against Tuyuhun. In Zhenguan 8, Duan Zhixuan was appointed Chief Commander of the Western Sea Route to raise a general counter-offensive, and the following year Li Jing went deep into Qinghai as Chief Commander of the same route and destroyed the state. Tuyuhun became a dependency of Tang, its people were settled in dependent prefectures, the Murong name was changed to that of Yuchi, and its pastures and fine horses came onto the register. The battle of Minzhou can be read as the first movement of that larger enterprise, but it also left a question behind: prefectural troops and surprise attacks could hold a line but never destroy an opponent, which is why the court later built route-level war zones and a standing system of frontier garrisons in the north-west. For Tuyuhun the same action brought a pause. It withdrew and sued for peace in the eighth month, buying years of quiet and time to recover its strength while Tang's attention was fixed on the north, until the matter was settled once and for all in the years around Zhenguan 9.
result: 結果也分兩層。戰場上：武德六年六月二十九日，柴紹在岷州山谷以聲音與舞蹈擾敵、遣精騎繞背突擊的戰術得手，吐谷渾軍大敗，被斬首五百餘級，潰兵退回吐谷渾本部；八月吐谷渾遣使請和，這條戰線暫時安靜下來，唐朝的岷州、洮州等邊州沒有失守，柴紹因功受到褒獎，這是唐初對吐谷渾少數乾淨漂亮的邊州勝利之一。戰略層面，它證明在隴右山地，步騎配合加奇襲可以抵消游牧騎兵的機動優勢；敵軍居高放箭雖佔了便宜，但只要注意力被短暫牽制，背後的騎兵就是致命的。戰役之外，唐朝並未因此罷手，吐谷渾在往後三年仍多次犯岷州、松州、疊州、河州，直到貞觀九年李靖大破其國才真正解決。於是623年6月那一戰的意義，更多在於示範與拖延：它為唐朝在西北贏得一個平靜的窗口，讓李淵得以把主力放在關東收拾劉黑闥與薛仁杲，也讓後來的唐太宗可以把西北那場大戰留到自己的手上。
resultEn: The outcome has two layers. On the field: on the twenty-ninth day of the sixth month of Wude 6, Chai Shao's combination of music and dance to pull the enemy's attention, followed by elite cavalry falling on its rear, worked at Minzhou. The Tuyuhun army was badly beaten, more than five hundred heads were taken, and the broken riders withdrew towards the Tuyuhun homeland. In the eighth month Tuyuhun sent an envoy to sue for peace, the line fell quiet for a time, the border prefectures of Minzhou and Taozhou were not lost, and Chai Shao was commended for the achievement; it was one of the few clean Tang victories over Tuyuhun won by a frontier force. At the strategic level it demonstrated that in the mountains of Longyou the combination of foot and horse with a surprise attack could cancel out the mobility advantage of nomadic cavalry: the enemy gained from shooting from the heights, but once attention was briefly diverted, cavalry at the back was fatal. Beyond the battlefield, Tang did not stop there, and Tuyuhun raided Minzhou, Songzhou, Diezhou and Hezhou repeatedly over the next three years, until Li Jing broke the state in Zhenguan 9 and the problem was truly solved. The meaning of the fight of June 623 therefore lies more in the demonstration it gave and the delay it bought: it won Tang a quiet window in the north-west, allowed Li Yuan to put his main army in the east against Liu Heita and Xue Rengao, and allowed the later Emperor Taizong to keep the great war in the north-west for his own hand.
